purpose: Current scientific figures for all eight place-based cases and the separate Sioux Falls demonstration benchmark. Preserve instance-specific facts and the selected Boston/Hong Kong presentation contract.

authority.explicit_user_choice: C的风格，A、B的配色，字体要serif字体（不是times，是serif）
authority.history_review: Both requested chats read in full;61 older turns+5 handoff turns and108 saved UI notes reviewed.
authority.numeric_defaults: Point sizes, colors and gaps are the verified existing renderer defaults, not invented quotations of user instructions.
authority.text_limit: No historical numeric word cap was found. Long explanatory prose, receipts and notices belong outside the canvas.
authority.latest_correction: Plot available saved data regardless of state count; remove failed attempts from current reader pages.

style.authority: verified executed renderer values, not user-specified numeric requirements

header.final_position: compact_header uses measured tight bounding boxes

palette.label: C 布局 · 蓝绿配色 · Serif
palette.description: 保留 C 的紧凑布局；采用 A/B 的蓝绿与深蓝；统一使用 DejaVu Serif 衬线字体。

style.no_verified_numeric_text_limit: No user-authorized maximum word/character count found. User requests short titles and moving long explanatory/count paragraphs outside. Any new lint word budget must be labelled implementation policy, not historical user wording.

roles.geographic: True saved physical geometry, top-down, equal aspect; no virtual arcs mixed into road totals.
roles.time_construction: Recorded semantic time layers allowed; one truthful construction card first, not decorative geography height.
roles.distribution: Use complete corresponding vector including zero values unless explicitly stated otherwise.
roles.iteration: Use actual saved iteration coordinates and all records. One or two saved states are plotted honestly with point markers, no fabricated intermediate samples. Never force a table based on state count.
roles.endpoint: Categorical endpoint scatter or exact point-versus-gate panels, supplementary to own-method spatial flow and full-vector distributions. Categories are not iterations.
roles.observation: Preserve source units and year; candidates/count inventories are not calibrated traffic.
roles.context_photo: Retain original licensed context image, never restyle it as a scientific result.

header.city: Uppercase city, optional short instance cue
header.title: Short algorithm or scientific question; no retired section number or implementation status
header.scope_details: Method version, model size, period, gate and detailed caveats live in adjacent subtitle/caption when they lengthen the header.

page_composition.single_row_columns: 1/2/3 equal-width cards when only one row; multi-row groups use three columns
page_composition.top_alignment: Image tops and caption starts aligned within each row
page_composition.canonical_evidence: One current rendering per evidence question; previous versions are original-download archive references, not competing current cards
page_composition.notice: Exact attribution linked beside each current asset; shared city notice avoids repeated paragraphs
page_composition.failed_attempts: Exclude failed method attempts, failed controls, resource failure logs and historical retry panels from current homepage, volume and interactive cards. Do not relabel them accepted; retain raw scientific files privately/local archive. Successful trajectories retain their early unconverged states.

scientific_templates.static_fw_b_finite: Own-method physical flow map plus complete all-link distribution. Same-instance alternatives share extent and scale. An objective-only scoreboard is not a substitute.
scientific_templates.native: Rank/representation variants grouped, own reconstructed absolute flow and signed difference to a valid same-instance reference. Iterative conservation diagnostic is supplementary; do not label identity80 as compressed26/52.
scientific_templates.cg: Phase I actual artificial quantity; Phase II real cost; full-graph pricing and actual new columns. LP same-graph reference. Separate each phase and distinguish states from updates.
scientific_templates.lr: Bounds/certified gap; multiplier prices; actual recovery/own pool. A new recovery hybrid is explicitly different from original pure subgradient LR. Missing own UB is unavailable, not0gap.
scientific_templates.admm: Original-unit feasibility, primal consensus, rho-scaled dual in its own unit, and same-graph objective difference. No rho-history panel. A single saved update is plotted as an actual point with gates; use own physical-flow/balance maps when data exist.
scientific_templates.foundations: Actual source region/roads/zones, all-zone population/households/jobs, dated services and observations. Generated inputs and later unused supplemental fields separated.
scientific_templates.four_stage: Generation, distribution, mode choice and assignment each retain their own purpose and units; persons→vehicles/PCE conversion exactly once.

export.sources_and_plot_data: Bind exact public source hashes and fields. Keep approved originals immutable; local redraws are presentation derivatives, not newly S0-signed original bytes.

checks: correct quantity/unit/role, not merely similar colors
city/title placement and selected serif fonts
no long in-canvas prose or stale release footer
no clipped/overlapping text or excessive outer whitespace
same asset on homepage and volume with working anchors
original scientific bytes preserved locally; failed attempts absent from current reader display
manual review of each changed figure at real display size

code_and_release.figure_commands: Read saved inputs and render only; no solver or matcher import as a hidden step.
code_and_release.computational_release: Existing r19 docs/r14 computation package remains a separately versioned historical artifact. Its41 commands and108-record catalog do not cover new city computational recipes.
code_and_release.current_work: Local website and reproducible figure pipeline only. No commit/push/deploy or new optimization.
code_and_release.publication_gate: Inspect current files, source/rights boundary, hashes, commands, site links and actual package equality; never reuse an old green check.

legacy_vector_exception.reason: Approved SVG exists but full public geometry is unavailable
legacy_vector_exception.preserve: scientific geometry, projection, original numeric labels and palette
legacy_vector_exception.require: per-figure source route, original hash and geometry verification
